**`schemas/syncbatch.schema.json`** (modified)
- Added `$defs/cursor`: opaque, URL-safe (`^[A-Za-z0-9._:/-]*$`), ≤1024 chars, `null` = "no position yet"; senders MUST only echo it, never interpret. `sinceCursor`/`cursor` now reference it.
